decisions.reason: This black-finish range is a low-risk extension of the firm's established drainage know-how and design-led positioning, so its strong fit with existing capabilities makes withdrawal unlikely.

The shower channel for seamless coverings sits close to the firm's core technical and architectural competence and remained prominently marketed across 2023 and 2024, which supports continued commitment.

The pump-drain shower channel is strategically relevant but less closely aligned with the firm's traditional gravity-drainage knowledge, so despite likely learning from the earlier pump-assisted offer it carries a materially higher risk of being discontinued if market acceptance or technical performance disappoints.
